shared_assumptions: Solver and verifier read the same frozen ProblemSpec; an exact solution or source that is physically wrong but mutually consistent would pass (this is code verification, not model validation).
The independent reference solve uses the same standard Galerkin weak form; it checks the implementation of that discretization, not the choice of discretization.
Element vertex coordinates and dof node coordinates are taken from solver-exported artifacts; their consistency is checked but the mesh generator itself is MFEM's.
The local basis is assumed to be nodal (Lagrange) at the exported node points, which holds for MFEM's default H1 Gauss-Lobatto basis; any violation surfaces as a self-report mismatch.
